$comment: The plugin UI vocabulary the design kits render (flare-plugin-protocol UiVocabulary). Hosts pass each kit's PLUGIN_UI_VOCABULARY to the engine through plugin.set_host_profile (kitVocabulary); the engine intersects it with its own vocabulary and the host's native allowlist. `vocabulary` is what every kit renders; `kits.<kit>.omit` lists names a kit does not render yet, so it never reports them. Generated into each kit by spec/build-plugin-ui-vocabulary.mjs; `--check` fails when a generated file is out of date. Add a name here only once every kit not omitting it renders it. Additive fields need no name here: a resolved field or row cell may carry tone and unmapped (from {label, tone} values), a status block, badge or timeline status unmapped, an action group (common | records) and icon (a kit icon name), a page view's tabs and a rows block's icon; a kit that ignores them draws as before (docs/plugin-experience.md R2, R3, 4.7). A kit line removes its omit entry once it renders the name.
